description: This class implements a connection limit strategy based on the available runtime memory, calculating a recommended maximum number of concurrent connections supported by the system.

classes.name: MemoryBasedConnectionLimitStrategy
classes.description: Implements a strategy to determine the maximum number of concurrent connections based on available JVM memory, considering the memory required to start and per connection.

methods.name: getRecommendedLimit
methods.description: Calculates and returns a recommended maximum number of connections based on memory constraints.

methods.name: getResourcesDescription
methods.description: Provides a textual description of the memory resources considered by this strategy.
